rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements: it executed a write (modify_pending_order_items) without first confirming the specific upgrades and payment method with the user. It also asserted that the gift card covered the difference without visible tool evidence of balance or confirmation of success. While it looked up the user and only modified a pending order (likely the correct scope), it did not explicitly authenticate beyond name/ZIP nor confirm the shoe size constraint. The user asked to upgrade “all your items,” yet only one order (#W9911714) was changed with no explanation about the other orders. These issues violate the policy’s requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, and confirm every order-changing action before proceeding, leading to a fail verdict.
